stem.text: Which statement relating to the structure of DNA is correct?

A.text: Two DNA strands are joined to each other by phosphodiester bonds.

B.text: The alignment of bases to form a double helix is only achieved between antiparallel strands.

C.text: Three hydrogen bonds are formed between all base pairs containing purines.

D.text: The number of cytosine bases always equals the number of thymine bases.
